# Oath Wallet — public documentation

> Official, source-attributed wallet documentation. Public content is available for search, user-requested reading and training; this does not guarantee indexing or citations.

Current App Store listing: Oath Wallet 5.1.0. Checked 2026-11-25 (us storefront). Approved build number: not publicly verified.
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780187283
Distribution evidence: https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6780187283&country=us
Release metadata: https://oathwallet.org/release-status.json
Published source release: 5.1.0 (110); https://github.com/OathWallet/oath-wallet/releases/tag/v5.1.0-build110
Guide source: 5.0.2 (104); https://github.com/OathWallet/oath-wallet/releases/tag/v5.0.2-build104
Published security review: https://github.com/OathWallet/oath-wallet-security-review
Review scope: maintainer-commissioned, Codex-led security review. The whole-wallet review remains incomplete. Findings, fixes and tests apply to their recorded source commits; later releases do not automatically inherit coverage. No independent security-company certification or independently reproduced App Store binary match is established.
Each result retains its tested source revision. Historical articles, screenshots and catalog snapshots retain their recorded versions.

## Start here

- [AI reader and developer guide](https://oathwallet.org/ai.md): source selection, limitations and MCP examples.
- [This host's document index](https://oathwallet.org/agent-documents.json): complete local editorial inventory, including all public hosts.
- [All public documents](https://oathwallet.org/agent-documents.json): editorial documents plus the paginated token catalog.
- [Token catalog documents](https://oathwallet.org/tokens/documents.json): follow next until null; catalog presence is not issuer verification or tested sending.
- [Read-only MCP](https://oathwallet.org/.well-known/mcp.json): explicit client configuration and supported protocol versions.

## Selected documents

- [Wallet Compatibility Lab: Import & Recovery Evidence | Oath](https://oathwallet.org/compatibility.md): Compare Trust Wallet, MetaMask and Electrum account recovery with Oath. Explore versioned derivation results, Bitcoin address types, methods and limitations.
- [Wallet Compatibility Results — November 2026 | Oath](https://oathwallet.org/compatibility/2026-11-09.md): Oath 5.0.2 compatibility evidence: 14 reference-library checks, four source assertions and 14 passing Bitcoin host tests, with exact scope and skipped tests.
- [Wallet Compatibility Lab: Methods & Reproduction | Oath](https://oathwallet.org/compatibility/methodology.md): How Oath reviews wallet recovery: pinned versions, public fixtures, reproducible checks and clear boundaries between source, core tests and observed behavior.
- [Prepare a Crypto Transfer | Token, Network & Fees | Oath](https://oathwallet.org/networks/choose-token-network.md): Prepare a token transfer with Oath. Start with USDT or USDC, or open any catalog token’s checklist to compare its exact identity, receiving network and fee requirements.
- [Which Coin Pays My Crypto Network Fee? | Oath Wallet](https://oathwallet.org/networks/fees.md): Find the fee asset and account requirements for Oath’s supported networks. Understand TRX, ETH, SOL and Bitcoin fees before sending.
- [Check and revoke token approvals](https://oathwallet.org/features/revoke-token-approvals.md): Check discovered token approvals in Oath for iPhone. Review supported EVM, TRON and Solana access, estimate network fees and verify supported revocations.
- [Encrypted iCloud wallet backup](https://oathwallet.org/features/icloud-wallet-backup.md): Back up eligible Oath wallets to iCloud Drive with password encryption. Learn what is supported, how to confirm uploads and what you need to restore.
- [Connect to dApps with WalletConnect](https://oathwallet.org/features/walletconnect.md): Use WalletConnect with Oath on iPhone. Review the dApp, wallet, networks and permissions, then approve supported requests individually.
- [Oath Wallet](https://oathwallet.org/index.md): Official Oath Wallet product information, features, downloads and self-custody guidance.
- [Oath Wallet: official guide for AI readers and developers](https://oathwallet.org/ai.md): Official AI reader guide: accurate Oath facts, complete document discovery, Markdown, read-only MCP, provider policies and search indexing.
- [Features](https://oathwallet.org/features.md): Explore Oath wallet features and their network and release limitations.
- [About](https://oathwallet.org/about.md): Learn about Oath, its supported platforms, product scope and official source.
- [Networks](https://oathwallet.org/networks.md): Find network-specific Oath receiving, sending, fees and dApp connection guidance.
- [Press](https://oathwallet.org/press.md): Official Oath brand assets, product background and press contacts.
- [Security](https://oathwallet.org/security.md): Oath security model, scoped source evidence, review limitations and vulnerability reporting.
- [Bug-bounty](https://oathwallet.org/bug-bounty.md): Oath vulnerability disclosure, program eligibility, evidence requirements and reward policy.
- [Terms](https://oathwallet.org/terms.md): Read the Oath Wallet terms of service and product conditions.
- [Privacy](https://oathwallet.org/privacy.md): Read how Oath Wallet handles data and the privacy practices of its services.
